question:
The figure is an aerial photo of a parking lot. Overlay a 5x5 grid on the image: cell (r, c) means row r counting from the top and column c counting from the left, both 1-based. How many cars have their centre inside cell (2, 3)?
(A) 3
(B) 2
(C) 1
(D) 5

Answer with only the correct option letter.
